mintAuthority.summary: yoUSD is an ERC-4626 strategy-vault variant with three independently issued local share deployments on Base, Ethereum, and Arbitrum. USDC issuance is inherited from Circle on each chain, while yoUSD shares are created through user deposit/mint entrypoints with no current privileged mint capability. The chain-local RolesAuthority governs strategy execution, redemption fulfilment, and pause; the 4-of-6 Safe proposes a 2-day TimelockController upgrade path that can replace local mint logic, so the mint-scoped posture is none-resolved-mint with a raiseable upgrade path.

controls.label: yoUSD Base admin Safe
controls.evidence: At Base block 50068513 on 2026-08-16, current Safe reads confirmed the YO admin Safe has six owners, threshold 4, empty module pagination, zero guard, and Safe version 1.4.1+L2. This Safe holds PROPOSER_ROLE on the 2-day TimelockController (0x38ce5e45d0f5d03e83863bb19b3b1a272c186f48), which owns the ProxyAdmin (0x12e81209d180ff0b3fbfbfe8fa9ffdb5990e1073) controlling the Base yoUSD vault upgrade. The Safe is not a current or authorizable share minter.

controls.label: yoUSD Base authority contract
controls.evidence: At Base block 50068513 on 2026-08-16, yoUSD.authority() returned this Solmate RolesAuthority, whose owner() is the 4-of-6 YO admin Safe. Against the current ABI-visible vault implementation 0xcff43a89d3ee3ad8dab0117cf679f45a34c87aa7, getRolesWithCapability returned roles 11, 12, and 17 for manage, role 15 for fulfillRedeem, and roles 13 and 14 for pause/unpause, while mint and deposit both returned a zero role bitmap with isCapabilityPublic=false. This authority governs strategy execution, redemption fulfilment, and pausing; it does not authorize share creation.

controls.label: yoUSD Base ERC-4626 vault (share mint on deposit)
controls.evidence: At Base block 50068513 on 2026-08-16, the local proxy's current EIP-1967 implementation was 0xcff43a89d3ee3ad8dab0117cf679f45a34c87aa7. The current ABI exposes deposit(uint256,address) and mint(uint256,address), and the RolesAuthority returns a zero, non-public capability result for both selectors; share creation is therefore user deposit-driven at NAV with no privileged share-mint path resolved.

controls.label: yoUSD Base ProxyAdmin owner TimelockController
controls.evidence: At Base block 50068513 on 2026-08-16, the vault's EIP-1967 implementation was 0xcff43a89d3ee3ad8dab0117cf679f45a34c87aa7 and its admin was ProxyAdmin 0x12e81209d180ff0b3fbfbfe8fa9ffdb5990e1073. ProxyAdmin.owner() was this TimelockController and getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds. An implementation change through that owned ProxyAdmin can alter local share-mint logic after the enforced two-day delay.

review.evidence: Reviewed on 2026-08-16 across Base block 50068513, Ethereum block 25771204, and Arbitrum block 495309899. YO's official contract inventory and gateway documentation describe three independent local ERC-4626 yoUSD deployments, each receiving and redeeming against its chain-local USDC; shares received on one chain cannot be redeemed on another. Each local proxy currently resolves to implementation 0xcff43a89d3ee3ad8dab0117cf679f45a34c87aa7, with ProxyAdmin 0x12e81209d180ff0b3fbfbfe8fa9ffdb5990e1073 owned by TimelockController 0x38ce5e45d0f5d03e83863bb19b3b1a272c186f48 with a 172800-second delay. The same YO Safe is 4-of-6 with no modules and zero guard on all three chains and holds the timelock proposer path. Current RolesAuthority reads show no role and no public capability for mint or deposit on any chain; the authority instead governs manage, fulfillRedeem, and pause/unpause. yoUSD share creation is therefore deposit-driven with no current privileged share-mint path, while the delayed upgrade path can replace local mint logic. USDC parent issuance is inherited on each chain; no Circle bridge control is imported into yoUSD Mint Authority. The mint-scoped posture is none-resolved-mint and economicCapSemantics remains raiseable.
